about: Nizhnevartovsk Airport became international after reconstruction in 2005. Runway 3,200 by 60 m. The second-largest airport of KhMAO-Yugra by traffic volume.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: 4 km to the city centre. City buses: No. 4 to U Severnoy Roshchi settlement, No. 9 to Starovartovskaya, No. 15 to the railway station and bus station, No. 21 to DRSU. An airport bus to Strezhevoy runs from the station forecourt; timetable on the bus station website. The taxi rank is on the station forecourt opposite terminal No. 2.

terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.text: Two terminals: No. 1 and No. 2. Electronic boarding passes are currently not accepted for pre-flight procedures; a paper one is required.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Business lounge on Level 1 of terminal 1, open round the clock. Admits business class passengers and holders of elite airline cards, others for a fee if places are available. Departure 7,950 ₽ for 2 h 30 min, each following hour 1,141 ₽. Arrival, meeting or seeing off 4,050 ₽. Children 2–12 years 70 % of the fare, under 2 free.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Terminal No. 1, Level 1, open round the clock. A suitcase, bag or backpack up to 203 cm (sum of three dimensions): 600 ₽ per day. Oversized items 700 ₽ per day. Lost tag 400 ₽.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: The mother and child room is available only with a ticket for a departure within the next 24 hours. Free for women with children under 7 and disabled children. Others pay 1,200 ₽ per bed per day.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Car park on the station forecourt. Up to 15 minutes free, then 200 ₽ per hour up to 5 hours. First 24 hours 1,000 ₽, each further 24 hours 800 ₽. A repeat entry within 30 minutes is paid from the moment of entry. Machines in terminals 1 and 2 accept banknotes only; the cashier at the exit accepts cards and QR.
